user.title: Boiler Demand
user.description: Switch the boiler on and off from how far your radiator valves are open.

data_description.switch_entity: Relay on the boiler's room-thermostat contact (switch or input_boolean).

valves.title: Radiator valves
valves.description: {count} valve sensors were found and pre-selected. Add or remove sensors that report valve opening in %.

data_description.valves: Sensors reporting valve opening in %. Unavailable or negative values are ignored.

data_description.on_threshold: Boiler turns on as soon as any valve is at least this far open.
data_description.off_threshold: Boiler turns off once all valves are at or below this. Must be lower than the on threshold.
data_description.min_on_minutes: Boiler stays on at least this long before it may turn off.
data_description.min_off_minutes: Boiler stays off at least this long before it may turn on again.
data_description.failsafe_after_minutes: How long all valves must be offline before the failsafe acts.
data_description.failsafe_mode: What to do with the boiler when no valve reports data.

error.no_valves: Select at least one valve sensor.
error.off_above_on: The off threshold must be lower than the on threshold.

abort.already_configured: This boiler switch is already controlled by Boiler Demand.
